system.notes:
A mini-grenade for a grenade launcher (SR3 p.283): the Smoke (IR) Grenade's effects, fired rather than thrown. It does not arm until it has travelled about five metres (SR3 p.118).

SR3 p.283, the Mini-grenade row applied to the Smoke (IR) Grenade row: Conceal 8, Weight .1, Availability 4/48 hrs +2, Cost 40¥ ×2, Street Index 2 +1. Legality 5-J. No blast.
system.areaEffect: An infra-red smoke cloud 20 m across for 2 Combat Turns: hot particles obscure thermographic vision as well as normal sight.
